hints.title: Recursive Outer Digit Wrapping
hints.text: A length n strobogrammatic string can be constructed by wrapping a length n - 2 strobogrammatic string with valid rotation pairs.

hints.title: Valid Symmetric Pairs and Leading Zero Prevention
hints.text: Valid reversible digit pairs are 11, 88, 69, 96, and 00. Zero pairs may only be placed inside the number, never at the outermost boundaries.

hints.title: Base Cases for Even and Odd Lengths
hints.text: If length is 0 return empty string; if 1 return 0, 1, and 8. Recursively obtain strings for length m - 2. For each, wrap with 11, 88, 69, 96, and 00 when m < total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(5^(N/2)) time matching the total number of generated valid strobogrammatic strings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 10^N numbers and filtering takes exponential time in base 10.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constructive inward-outward recursive expansion generates only valid strings with zero dead branches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle base cases 0 and 1 cleanly and exclude leading zeros at the outermost layer.
